_about: Sprint 18 wave 2 (s18-g-chaat; the sprint's 'Coded well' rule 1: a game is its settings file plus its own mechanic): chaat's own numbers, read by js/cook/mechanics/assemble.js before it builds; everything else is a kit call. CHT-13 (Zafar, 9 Nov: 'I think maybe we go top down for chaat ... Opaque bowl looks better than the glass bowl'; built by s19-chaat-td, 11 Nov): everything seen from above. bowl: the opaque cream serving bowl (file), in shares of the kitchen frame's play area (Sprint 20, s20-b2-chaat; Cook.Frame.area's play: js/cook/frame.js): its drawn width (d, a share of the play area's width), its middle across and down (x, y, shares of the play area's width and height: the middle of the worktop that shows) and how far below that (low, a share of its own width), the middle of its opening as fractions of the picture (cx, cy), the food's circle as a share of the bowl's half-width (food), the layers' canvas px per world px (res), where a layer's soft edge starts (edge, a share of the food's radius), the inside wall's shade over the food's edge (wallShade), the warm glow's size as a share of d (warm). tray: the row on the kit's stone tray (band 'tray'): the slot each bowl wants (pitch), a bowl's width (bowlD, narrower where the slots ask), between a bowl's foot and its pill's top (gap), the least room above a bowl under the tray's top (top), the span the row is centred on (span, shares of the play area's width: its edges just past the play area's, as the sheet's 30 to 1570 were); the pills stand on the band's line (St.SHELF.chipY); the pills are the shared kit's (js/shared/shelf.js) at chai's size. bowls: each topping's cream bowl from above (the full run's F3, cut to assets/cook/items/v4/chaat/), and in it the food's middle (cx, cy) and radius (food, a share of the picture's width) and a spoonful's (spoon). layers: each topping's own picture laid in the bowl (the full run's C5-C11; the chutneys are their drizzles, Zafar 10 Nov): its width as a share of the food's (k, varied by kJitter), how far off the middle (spread), the shadow under its pieces (shade: offset x, y and blur in world px, alpha a), where a spoonful lands (land, a share of the food's radius) and how small a layer starts as it grows in from there (from). heap: a topping with no layer picture (the base, potato and chickpeas, and sev: Fable's 'two scatter pictures overlap, whichever was added second on top') is its tray bowl's food stamped in discs: a stamp's radius as a share of the food's (r: a whole bowl's food, so its pieces are the layers' size), the stamps' spacing when it covers the floor as the first thing in (grid, of r) and their opaque middle (solid); a later one lies in heaps: each a share of its bowl's food (heap) at the same scale, softer edged (heapSolid), how many (heaps), how far out (reach) and their size (min, up to 2 - min, of a heap). motion: the spoonful (spoonW design px, its drop from dropPx above where it lands over dropMs), its flight back (backMs), the layer growing in (fillMs, CK-83: about 0.9 s, never a snap), a wrong thing's pause before the shake and its way out (notInMs, notInPauseMs, outMs, shakePx), a double tap (doubleTapMs), the right bowl's moment (rightHoldMs), the right way shown (showGlowMs, showHoldMs), the recast's cap (recastCapMs), the word pop's place from the bowl's right edge and middle (popDx, popDy), the review face's size (reviewD), the end (endMs). levels: what changes by level over data.mechanics.assemble (flyMs: a spoonful's flight to the bowl, about 15% quicker a level, STD-C2-06). The decoys and the counts are the central rules' (data/rules.json), never here (STD-F2-02).
_band: SH-248 (Zafar, 10 Nov): this game's bottom row, read by St.stoneBand(S, {game}); "tray" for top-down things, "shelf" for side-on (docs/game-design/modes/cook-bottom-row.md). CHT-13 (Zafar, 9 Nov): chaat is top-down on the tray (was 'shelf', the side-on glass jars).

layers._files: Zafar, 10 Nov: the chutneys are the drizzles (C5-drizzle #111, C10-drizzle #110); the ribbons (layer-lili, layer-amli) stay cut, unused. s19-k3 (C12-3, CK-85): potato, chickpeas and sev have their own top-down scatters now (layer-bataato, layer-chana, layer-sev), no longer stamped from their bowl's food.
layers._ring: CHT-20 (the Fable eye judge for Zafar, decision 38, chaat L1: every layer added stays visible): each layer lies this share of its width narrower than the one beneath it (ring a layer under it), never under ringMin of its width, so each layer shows round the edge of those on top

_assets: S19 (decision 68, loadcheck): every picture chaat loads beyond data/cook.json art.assets.stations: the serving bowl, the F3 bowls on the tray and the layer pictures (CHT-13, s19-chaat-td)

served._about: CHT-20 (decision 38: the bowl the child built is the dish served, as chai's glass): the picture of the built bowl chaat hands the serve (Cook.Serve.plated, js/cook/serve.js): its width in px (w), the bowl's share of it (share: the serve draws a handed dish at a plate's size class, 0.58 of the tray; a bowl's class is 0.39, so the bowl lies in 0.39/0.58 of the picture), its height for its width as the family sees it on the tray (tilt; maani's plates 0.56) and the kit's one soft shadow down and to the right (SH-268), px of the picture

_tray22: CHT-22 (the Fable eye judge for Zafar, decision 38, 740x320: 'the stone tray reading full as chai's shelf'): the bowls on the tray about a seventh bigger (bowlD 150 -> 172, pitch 180 -> 200), still narrower where the slots or the tray's height ask; the spoonful never under spoonCss CSS px (motion.spoonCss)
